functions.name: restock
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION inventory.restock(stock_id bigint, amount integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  UPDATE inventory.stock SET quantity = quantity + amount
  WHERE id = stock_id
  RETURNING quantity;
$function$

functions.name: author_book_counts
functions.definition:
SELECT authors.name, count(books.id)
  FROM public.authors
  LEFT JOIN public.books ON books.author_id = authors.id
  GROUP BY authors.name
  HAVING count(books.id) >= min_books;
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.author_book_counts(min_books integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(author_name text, book_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT authors.name, count(books.id)
  FROM public.authors
  LEFT JOIN public.books ON books.author_id = authors.id
  GROUP BY authors.name
  HAVING count(books.id) >= min_books;
$function$

functions.name: book_titles
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.book_titles()
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, title text, author_name text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT books.id,
     books.title,
     authors.name
    FROM (books
      LEFT JOIN authors ON ((authors.id = books.author_id)));
END
functions.return_type: TABLE(id bigint, title text, author_name text)

functions.name: books_of
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.books_of(author_name text, max_price numeric)
 RETURNS SETOF books
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT books.* FROM public.books
  JOIN public.authors ON authors.id = books.author_id
  WHERE authors.name = author_name AND books.price <= max_price;
$function$

functions.name: search_books
functions.definition:
SELECT * FROM public.books
  WHERE books.title ILIKE '%' || query || '%'
    AND (search_books.mood IS NULL OR books.mood = search_books.mood)
    AND (max_price IS NULL OR books.price <= max_price);
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_books(query text, mood mood DEFAULT NULL::mood, max_price numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric)
 RETURNS SETOF books
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT * FROM public.books
  WHERE books.title ILIKE '%' || query || '%'
    AND (search_books.mood IS NULL OR books.mood = search_books.mood)
    AND (max_price IS NULL OR books.price <= max_price);
$function$
functions.argument_types: query text, mood mood DEFAULT NULL::mood, max_price numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric
functions.identity_argument_types: query text, mood mood, max_price numeric
